answer.rationale: The scheduled inspection of covered-process equipment triggers documentation of the inspection and application of the equipment-deficiency requirement. Because the vessel is outside acceptable limits, it must be corrected before further use unless necessary means are taken to assure safe operation while correction occurs in a safe and timely manner. Determining whether continued operation can be made safe requires qualified engineering and safety judgment.
answer.missing_information_or_escalation_reason: Escalate to qualified process-safety/engineering personnel to determine whether the vessel must be removed from service before further use or whether necessary means exist to assure safe operation pending timely correction.
